name: tastebridge
description: Local shared-activity workflow. Search public cultural entities, record explicit user-reviewed choices and practical facts, then compare a common shortlist. Never invent reviews, facts or vetoes. No bookings or payments. Unavailable or incomplete provider evidence must remain blocked.
transport: POST /api/tool on the same trusted loopback machine; X-TasteBridge-Token from GET /api/status

arguments.description: Use current session_id and revision after create. create: participants 2–6, budget, required_facts [] or [step_free]. search: role seed/candidate, public query, entity_type for seeds. confirm_entity: returned search_id/entity_id, participant for seeds, reviewed=true only after explicit review. candidate_facts: entity_id, cost_per_person, facts with step_free true/false/null, explicit guest vetoes, source_note, timezone-aware observed_at, reviewed=true. remove_entity: entity_id and participant for a seed, or entity_id only for a place. evaluate/state: current session context.

limitations: Function-tool contract, not a model-provider integration or MCP server
Explicit review input is recorded but reviewer identity is not authenticated
State expires; public deployment is not supported
Provider availability and real API validation are separate
